title: A pointer hover over an open overlay resolves inside that overlay, as a press does

needles: a hover over an open overlay resolves inside it like a press does
a hover over an open overlay moves and highlights its row, not the view beneath

installed_sdk.rationale: hover_target_at is declared in the installed overlay_dismissal.hpp beside route_press_to_active_overlay, and the existing installed verbs deliver_hover_move and hover_cursor_at now resolve through it. No signature an SDK consumer already calls changes; a tree with no open overlay resolves exactly as before. The delivery stays pending its installed-consumer proof.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler, or accepted document shape changes. Hover routing runs inside a live view tree, which the offline timeline CLI never constructs.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry, or handler changes. Nothing in tools/mcp routes pointer hovers.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes. The change decides which view a buttonless pointer move reaches; it adds no controllable operation.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. Hover routing over an open popover is host input plumbing, not a generator-facing design capability.
